investigated: Ordered 4B→4C→4D→4E→4F roadmap and per-slice approval/verification gates.

expandedCoverage.print: CSS print emulation, not printer output
expandedCoverage.scope: All route templates and representative reachable UI states; not every data record or every possible interaction.

stages.summaryEn: Strict policy validation, pinned evidence and stale-result rejection prevent unknown configurations from being silently approved.
stages.summaryAr: تحقق صارم من السياسة وبصمات الأدلة ورفض النتائج القديمة، من غير تخمين إن المجهول آمن.
stages.before: Prioritized semantic, runtime and automation planning, with independent approval gates; no implementation in this stage.
investigated: Unknown schema, stale pins and contradictory approvals are rejected; no automatic semantic approvals.
changes: Unknown schema, stale pins and contradictory approvals are rejected; no automatic semantic approvals.
unresolved: Tests prove safety fixtures, not every possible source grammar.

investigated: Independent semantic fixes accumulated; canonical data and en-US financial formatting retained.
changes: Independent semantic fixes accumulated; canonical data and en-US financial formatting retained.
unresolved: Representative commit aggregates earlier repairs; each fixing commit is listed separately. Seed screenshots do not exercise every mixed-script permutation.

limitations: Representative commit aggregates earlier repairs; each fixing commit is listed separately. Seed screenshots do not exercise every mixed-script permutation.

expandedCoverage.print: CSS print emulation, not printer output
expandedCoverage.scope: All route templates and representative reachable UI states; not every data record or every possible interaction.

stages.summaryEn: Conservative CSS codemod plans, dry runs, guarded apply and rollback. Production approvals/candidates remain zero: no bulk production conversion occurred.
stages.summaryAr: خطط وتحويلات تجريبية وحواجز تطبيق واسترجاع؛ التحويلات المعتمدة في الإنتاج صفر، ومفيش bulk migration حصل.
stages.before: Representative cumulative checkpoint after sidebar, chart, KPI, brand, navigation and bidi slices. Forms/dialogs/tables were verified before speculative overrides.
investigated: Read-only dry-run default, exact plan guards, external journals, fixture/idempotency/rollback tests.
changes: Read-only dry-run default, exact plan guards, external journals, fixture/idempotency/rollback tests.
unresolved: Apply/rollback demonstrations belong to fixtures. No production source was transformed for this collection.
